brief.text: Berkshire Hathaway’s $136,382,789 position in Lennar Corp (LEN) dwarfs all other activity, exceeding the second-largest individual transaction by over $129 million. In cluster activity, Bank Bradesco (BBD) saw an extraordinary 21 insiders participate for a combined $28,952,210, far surpassing Dick's Sporting Goods (DKS) where 6 insiders accounted for $5,088,794. Real Estate Investment Trusts and Closed-End Funds also represent recurring industries across the filings, highlighted by cluster activity in Agree Realty Corp (ADC) at $4,142,871 and Howard Hughes Holdings (HHH) at $1,667,428.
